edits.after: Since time is short, we should cherish it; since we cannot relive the past, we should choose what truly matters; since the end is certain, we should not waste life on the unimportant.
edits.reason: Cannot redo past life does not mean one cannot make a fresh start; clarify the intended irreversibility.
edits.before: Since time is short, we should cherish it; since we cannot start over, we should choose what truly matters; since the end is certain, we should not waste life on the unimportant.

edits.after: Como hay poco tiempo, debemos valorarlo; como no podemos repetir lo ya vivido, debemos elegir lo realmente importante; como el final llegará, no debemos desperdiciar la vida en asuntos insignificantes.
edits.reason: Avoid implying that a fresh start is impossible; the source concerns inability to redo elapsed life.
edits.before: Como hay poco tiempo, debemos valorarlo; como no podemos volver a empezar, debemos elegir lo realmente importante; como el final llegará, no debemos desperdiciar la vida en asuntos insignificantes.

edits.after: El final es un hecho. Impide deshacer ilimitadamente las elecciones y convierte la pérdida en parte de la vida. Pero cada persona debe formar su propio juicio, desde sus circunstancias, relaciones y razones, sobre qué merece por ello conservarse, asumirse y continuarse.
edits.reason: Repair the awkward grammatical object of debe formarlo while preserving personal formation of value judgment.
edits.before: El final es un hecho. Impide deshacer ilimitadamente las elecciones y convierte la pérdida en parte de la vida. Pero qué merece por ello conservarse, asumirse y continuarse debe formarlo cada persona desde sus circunstancias, relaciones y razones.

edits.after: Como si vivir de verdad tuviera que ser intenso, valiente y sin reservas. Pero muchos cambios importantes no aparecen de forma intensa. Alguien puede simplemente dejar de aceptar una exigencia que ya no le corresponde, escuchar con atención una conversación completa o seguir practicando sin aplausos.
edits.reason: Naturalize accepting one fewer demand, preserving all three examples of undramatic change.
edits.before: Como si vivir de verdad tuviera que ser intenso, valiente y sin reservas. Pero muchos cambios importantes no aparecen de forma intensa. Alguien puede simplemente aceptar una exigencia menos que ya no le corresponde, escuchar con atención una conversación completa o seguir practicando sin aplausos.

edits.after: Una vida necesita saber que tiene un final y seguir construyendo sin saber cuándo llegará.
edits.reason: Knowing there is an endpoint is not knowing the ending in advance; retain the explicit uncertainty about when.
edits.before: Una vida necesita conocer su final y seguir construyendo sin saber cuándo llegará.

edits.after: Part of our fear of death lies precisely in the change to this structure. We do not merely stop holding life temporarily; from the living person's perspective, there is no later moment to take it up again.
edits.reason: Our fear of death, not fear possessed by death itself; retain the person's perspective qualification.
edits.before: Part of death's fear lies precisely in the change to this structure. We do not merely stop holding life temporarily; from the living person's perspective, there is no later moment to take it up again.

edits.after: Length of time and quantity of achievements describe certain aspects of life; they cannot provide a complete measure of a person.
edits.reason: Natural prose for the limit of evaluating a person, not literally finishing an act of measurement.
edits.before: Length of time and quantity of achievements describe certain aspects of life; they cannot finish measuring a person.

edits.after: Quizá la plenitud de una vida no deba entenderse como ausencia de huecos.
edits.reason: Wholeness of life is plenitud here, not integridad with its possible moral-integrity implication; matches the surrounding terminology.
edits.before: Quizá la integridad de una vida no deba entenderse como ausencia de huecos.

edits.after: If a system has space, it seems able to take on more. Every stretch of time saved is thus immediately filled with new tasks, until any unexpected event causes collapse.
edits.reason: Repair the unnatural every time savings noun phrase.
edits.before: If a system has space, it seems able to take on more. Every time savings is thus immediately filled with new tasks, until any unexpected event causes collapse.

edits.after: No lo conservamos porque sepamos qué ocurrirá, sino porque reconocemos que no conocemos todo el futuro ni sabemos si nuestro orden actual de valores siempre será correcto.
edits.reason: Clarify limited knowledge of the whole future, not a claim that we know nothing about it, and retain uncertainty about current values.
edits.before: No lo conservamos porque sepamos qué ocurrirá, sino porque reconocemos que desconocemos todo el futuro y si nuestro orden actual de valores siempre será correcto.

edits.after: Much of our time is spent maintaining things, waiting, or recovering; some of it has no clear content at all. It is not thereby deducted from life. A person is not a project required to turn all its reserves into output.
edits.reason: Repair mixed time-is-maintenance/lacks-content construction while retaining every ordinary use and the complete conclusion.
edits.before: Much time is merely maintenance, waiting, recovery, or even lacks clear content. It is not thereby deducted from life. A person is not a project required to turn all its reserves into output.

edits.after: Por eso, precisamente porque el tiempo es limitado, no debemos llenarlo por completo.
edits.reason: Do not add a quantitative claim that the less time we have, the less we should fill it; preserve the source's reason not to fill all time.
edits.before: Por eso, cuanto más limitado es el tiempo, menos debemos llenarlo por completo.

review_scope.method: Read every Chinese, English and Spanish paragraph from the formal incoming ZIP, comparing meaning, argument, examples and qualifications; checked paragraph alignment against supplied Markdown. Local edits preserve paragraph positions and complete argument.
review_scope.limitations: Editorial and cross-language review, not independent empirical verification of every general claim. No site files edited or incoming scripts executed.
review_scope.truncation_recovery: All paragraph readings were bounded and untruncated; no unread text certified.
